explanation: Before inserting a duration into a set, check whether its complement has appeared earlier.
correctness: A match in the set always uses an earlier distinct position. Every legal pair is found when its later position is scanned.
walkthrough: For movieLengths=[35,60,45,20] and flightLength=80, remember 35, then 60. At duration 45, the needed complement is 35, which is already from a different position, so return true. A single duration 40 would not be enough by itself.
edgeCases: One movie of length 40 cannot fill target 80, but two entries [40,40] can. Empty input returns false.
timeComplexity: Expected O(n) time: each duration performs one hash lookup and at most one insertion.
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary space: the set may retain every distinct earlier duration.
